title: oenanthe montana
intro: Oenanthe montana, commonly known as Water Fern or Mountain Water Fern, is a perennial plant species belonging to the carrot family (Apiaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Oenanthe montana include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and ease respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
